titre: Qualifier un appel d'offres : fit et chances de gain
description: Chaque avis de marché repéré (BOAMP, plateformes d'acheteurs, veille) passe devant Jev avec un résumé de son texte. Jev rend deux notes de 0 à 3, le fit avec l'offre et les chances de gagner, et on ne lit en entier que les avis notés 2 ou 3 sur les deux. La grille décrit une agence de développement web et data de 40 personnes à Lyon : à réécrire pour votre offre et vos contraintes (taille, certifications, zone).

instructions.offer: We are a 40-person agency in Lyon building custom web applications, data platforms and public websites, with hosting and maintenance. We do not sell hardware, network infrastructure, ERP licences, printing or training alone.
instructions.question: Given `offer`, rate how closely the tender (`objet` and `texte`, published by `acheteur`) matches what we sell.

criteria: 0, out of scope: works, cleaning, supplies, catering, legal or financial services, anything unrelated to software or digital services.
1, distant: IT or digital but another trade: hardware or network supply, telephony, printing, ERP or licence purchase, pure training or consulting, audiovisual production.

2, close: a web, data or software mission where a large part of the scope is outside our offer: a mobile app, a heavy ERP integration, a data platform bundled with on-site infrastructure, or a mission where development is a minor lot.
3, core: custom web application, data platform, website or portal redesign with development, hosting and maintenance, exactly our offer.

instructions.constraints: We can staff up to 8 people on a project, mostly remote from Lyon. We hold no ISO 27001 or HDS certification. Our references are regional councils, universities, public agencies and mid-sized companies, all in France. Budgets under 30 k€ are not worth the response effort; budgets over 1 M€ are beyond our size.
instructions.question: Given `constraints`, rate our chances of winning the tender described in `texte`. Look for eliminatory requirements, budget, deadline, award criteria and any sign of an incumbent.

criteria: 0, no chance: an eliminatory requirement we do not meet (ISO 27001 or HDS required, more than 8 people on site, a mandatory office outside France, budget over 1 M€), or the text renews an existing contract with the current provider.
1, low: response deadline under 10 days, budget under 30 k€, award criteria weighted mostly on price, or wording that hints at a preferred provider ('reconduction', 'prestataire en place').
2, fair: budget between 30 k€ and 500 k€, criteria weighted on technical quality, no eliminatory requirement, a buyer type we have already served.

3, high: all of level 2 plus a public buyer or a sector where we hold references (collectivités, universités, agences publiques), a scope sized for a team of 3 to 8 people, and a deadline of three weeks or more.
